flaws.description: Changed ax1.bar(...) to ax1.plot(...) for the tax revenue series (converting the bar chart to a line), removing the width= keyword which plot() does not accept.
Replaced the true chart title 'Tax Revenue and GDP Contribution in Vanuatu (2000-2010)' with a fabricated, unrelated title 'Population Growth and Literacy Rate in Fiji (2000-2010)'.
Changed the 2004 Tax Revenue value in the inline data list from 150.7 to 67.8, corrupting one plotted point while the table retains the true value.
